text: Count of distinct factual (empirical, not purely normative/value) premises asserted in the OP's argument that are challenged (disputed, contradicted, or shown false/unsupported) by at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP; order is not chronology or rank). A premise challenged by multiple comments counts once; one comment challenging several different premises counts each. Do not count challenges to value judgments, purely normative conclusions, or OP wording only. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither announcement nor premise. Use current text including marked edits, not an initial snapshot. Output a non-negative integer (0 = no OP factual premise challenged); a valid empty comment list gives 0; missing or malformed argument or OC_comments gives null.
